deals.whyRanked: Allegiant one-way $61 (Jan 17), about $122–160 round trip; still the cheapest BOS fare, with Everglades NP ~1 h away.
deals.soloWhy: Walkable beach and Las Olas districts, free water taxi-style transit options, and easy day trips south.

highlights: Fort Lauderdale Beach promenade at sunrise
Las Olas Boulevard galleries and cafés
Water Taxi ride along the Intracoastal and New River
Shark Valley tram and bike loop in Everglades NP
Hugh Taylor Birch State Park for a quiet shaded walk
itinerary: Day 1 — Beach promenade, Las Olas lunch, sunset water taxi
Day 2 — Drive to Shark Valley (Everglades NP), rent a bike for the 15-mile loop
Day 3 — Hugh Taylor Birch State Park, then Wilton Manors for brunch
guide.gettingAround: A rental car is best for the Everglades; the beach and Las Olas area is walkable and the Water Taxi covers the waterways.
guide.stayArea: Near Las Olas / Beach area for walkability and hostel and budget hotel options.

deals.whyRanked: Allegiant one-way $62 (Jan 25), about $124–170 round trip; Gulf beaches and Myakka River State Park nearby.
deals.soloWhy: Compact downtown, free beach trolley options, and a safe, easygoing arts scene.

highlights: St. Armands Circle and Lido Key
itinerary: Day 1 — Siesta Key beach morning, downtown Main Street evening
Day 2 — Myakka River State Park canopy walk and airboat or kayak
Day 3 — Ringling grounds, then Lido Key sunset
guide.gettingAround: Car recommended; the Siesta Key trolley and downtown are manageable without one for short stays.
guide.stayArea: Downtown Sarasota or Siesta Village for walkability and beach access.

deals.whyRanked: Allegiant one-way $73 (Dec 31), up from $68 yesterday, about $146–195 round trip; Great Smoky Mountains NP is ~45 min away.
deals.soloWhy: Walkable Market Square and Old City, cheap lodging, and the Smokies are an easy solo day trip.

highlights: Sugarlands / Roaring Fork in the Smokies
Bike or walk the Knoxville Urban Wilderness
itinerary: Day 1 — Old City, Market Square, Sunsphere
Day 2 — Smokies day trip: Sugarlands Visitor Center and Roaring Fork
Day 3 — Ijams or Urban Wilderness trails before the flight
guide.gettingAround: Rental car needed for the Smokies; downtown is walkable.
guide.stayArea: Downtown or Old City to walk to food and nightlife.

deals.whyRanked: Allegiant one-way $88 (Nov 20), up from $81, about $176–225 round trip; no national park but an easy solo city break.
deals.soloWhy: Very walkable downtown and East Village with cheap, low-key lodging.

itinerary: Day 2 — Sculpture Park, Art Center, Gray's Lake loop
Day 3 — Saturday-style market stroll if timing allows, then depart
guide.gettingAround: Downtown is walkable; use rideshare for the Art Center.
guide.stayArea: East Village or downtown for walkability.

deals.whyRanked: Allegiant one-way $92 (Dec 31), about $184–235 round trip; Sleeping Bear Dunes within a car trip. Asheville dropped out: its in-window fare was not confirmed.
deals.soloWhy: Walkable downtown with a strong brewery and coffee scene and a short drive to the lakeshore.

itinerary: Day 3 — Lake Michigan day trip, then fly home
guide.gettingAround: Downtown is walkable; rent a car for the lakeshore.
